text: In sequent calculus LK (Gentzen), the weakening rule allows:
choices: removing a formula from a sequent
adding an arbitrary formula to the antecedent or succedent
explanation: Weakening (W): Γ⊢Δ ⇒ Γ,A⊢Δ (left) or Γ⊢A,Δ (right). It allows adding unused hypotheses or adding conclusions. Together with contraction and exchange it gives structural rules.
